user.title: HAFAS Bus Monitor
user.description: Configure one tile/stop per entity. Enter city and stop search term (for example "Kiel" and "Hospitalstraße"). Preferred lines are comma-separated; leave empty to show all lines. After selecting the stop, choose destinations per line. Polling runs every 30 seconds between 06:00 and 22:00; an optional holiday sensor pauses it during school holidays.

select_stop.title: Select stop
select_stop.description: {count} possible stops found for "{query}". Select the correct stop.

add_stop.title: Add another stop?
add_stop.description: {count} tile(s) configured: {stops}. Add another tile/stop to compare walking times for the fastest connection.

stop.title: Add stop
stop.description: Enter city, search term and line filter for the additional tile/stop.

targets.title: Select destinations
targets.description: Select the destinations for line {line} at {stop}. Leave everything unselected to show all destinations. You can select one or more destinations per line.

settings.title: Polling and routing settings
settings.description: The update interval controls how often HAFAS is queried while active (06:00–22:00). The look-ahead window controls how far into the future departures are requested. The optional holiday sensor pauses polling while it is on.

add_stop.title: Add stop
add_stop.description: Enter the city and stop search term, then select the correct HAFAS stop.

select_stop.title: Select stop
select_stop.description: {count} possible stops found for "{query}". Select the correct stop.

edit_stop.title: Edit stop
edit_stop.description: Select the stop whose line filter or walking time you want to change.

edit_stop_form.title: Edit {stop}
edit_stop_form.description: Change the line filter or walking time for this stop.

remove_stop.title: Remove stop
remove_stop.description: Select the stop to remove. At least one stop must remain.

targets.title: Select destinations
targets.description: Select the destinations for line {line} at {stop}. Leave everything unselected to show all destinations. You can select one or more destinations per line.

edit_targets.title: Edit destinations
edit_targets.description: Select the stop whose destination filter you want to change.
